content: Formalized description of BSW Abstract SWS Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall be able to publish formalized parts of a general SWS which then are inherited by derived specific SWSs. Rationale: Groups of BSW SWSs often share a common set of specification elements. These general specification elements should not be stated multiple times in order to avoid redundancy. Therefore a specific SWS should be able to inherit the general parts from an abstract SWS and focus on those elements that have to be specified in particular.
